breaking_news.headline: First-time homebuyers remain scarce, but a record share of them pay all cash
breaking_news.summary: A new report finds generational wealth is widening the divide between homebuyers and those priced out. The median age of first-time buyers also remains at a record high.

breaking_news.headline: Pasture mealybugs have killed off huge swaths of grasses in the Southeast
breaking_news.summary: An invasive insect that's tough to detect and eliminate poses a multi-billion dollar threat to the agricultural economy — adding another stressor to farmers already stretched by high costs.

breaking_news.headline: Fears of an AI crackdown after midterms spark $2 trillion rout in tech stocks
breaking_news.summary: Shares sank, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq dropping over 5%, as investors reacted with fear that a Democratic Congress — and states across the country -— would crack down on AI and data centers.

breaking_news.headline: Why gold prices are surprisingly low
breaking_news.summary: Gold tends to go up when there's uncertainty in the economy. For a while, the price reflected that. But this week, it dropped from a nearly $5,600 in January to below $4,000. What's going on?

breaking_news.headline: Hiring jumps: The economy added 165,000 jobs last month
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. job market improved last month, according to a report from the Labor Department Friday.  Employers added more jobs than forecasters had expected and the unemployment rate dipped to 4.1%.

breaking_news.headline: This was the week the AI trade cracked. So what's next?
breaking_news.summary: Big losses by AI shares in stock markets after Democrats won the midterm elections have left investors shaken and wondering comes next.

breaking_news.headline: The Cybertruck's 'cause of death?' Insufficient demand
breaking_news.summary: One of the most polarizing vehicles to hit the road will soon be a thing of history. Tesla will wind down manufacturing of its Cybertruck at the company's Gigafactory Texas mid-next year.

breaking_news.headline: Democrats won big. Can they lower your grocery bill?
breaking_news.summary: Affordability concerns were top of mind for voters heading into the midterms, as tariffs and the war in Iran drove up prices, including food costs. Now, Americans are expecting relief from Washington.

breaking_news.headline: At least 39 die after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal
breaking_news.summary: The Atlantic crossing to Spain's Canary Islands remains dangerous for migrants seeking a better life

breaking_news.headline: Russia's leading independent newspaper closes after eviction
breaking_news.summary: The outlet has been evicted from its offices of three decades and says it's been blocked from receiving donations.

breaking_news.headline: Nine Zimbabweans caught allegedly trying to leave South Africa to fight in Ukraine
breaking_news.summary: Hundreds of people from different African countries have been recruited to fight for Russia, according to Ukraine.

breaking_news.headline: Republican congressman to force impeachment vote on Defence Secretary Hegseth
breaking_news.summary: The effort will likely fail, but Representative Thomas Massie wants to push Trump to fire Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process.

breaking_news.headline: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people
breaking_news.summary: Eyewitnesses say the explosion shook the ground, with one believing an earthquake had hit near the Habas Demir Celik plant in Aliaga.

breaking_news.headline: Trump questions midterm elections integrity after previously accepting results
breaking_news.summary: Trump made the claims, without evidence, on Truth Social on Monday.

breaking_news.headline: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
breaking_news.summary: Tons of chilled and frozen food was spoiled last month as fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets heated up.

breaking_news.headline: Government's EV targets expected to be reduced this week
breaking_news.summary: New petrol or diesel cars are due to be phased out by 2030 and by 2035 all new cars must be zero emission.

breaking_news.headline: Doing these things now will help you save money at Christmas
breaking_news.summary: Small decisions made now can make a big difference to your festive finances, charities say, so here are some tips.

breaking_news.headline: What do we know about Nvidia CEO’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy?
breaking_news.summary: Adoration for the US tech giant’s CEO Jensen Huang has been labelled “Jensanity”, but can his reputation survive the news of his affair?

breaking_news.headline: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
breaking_news.summary: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.

breaking_news.headline: Poundland unable to buy new stock as fears over collapse grow
